Search messages in one folder (path query parameter required; \All covers everything on Gmail and MS Graph accounts)

mcp.description: Model Context Protocol server that lets AI agents work with the connected email accounts and manage the instance. Off by default; an admin enables it under Configuration > MCP

settings.name: mcpEnabled
settings.description: Runtime switch for the MCP endpoint. While off, /mcp answers 404

settings.name: mcpOAuthEnabled
settings.description: Built-in OAuth 2.1 authorization server for MCP clients that cannot use a static token. Requires mcpEnabled and serviceUrl

authentication.recommendedScope: mcp for the mail tools, mcp-manage for the instance management tools, both when an agent needs both
authentication.description: Bearer access token. A token with the mcp or mcp-manage scope opens this endpoint only and is refused by /v1. Every tool call is dispatched as the equivalent REST request with the same credential, so scopes, permissions, account binding, restrictions and the audit log all apply. Each MCP scope admits only the (action, group) grants of its own tools

levels.description: Default. Read accounts, settings, queues, OAuth2 applications, gateways, tokens, logs and statistics. Cannot change anything
levels.grants: read on account, settings, oauth2, license, token, gateway, webhook, blocklist, template, outbox, diagnostics, logs

levels.description: Observe, plus reconnect, add and test accounts, change settings, manage OAuth2 applications, gateways and templates
levels.grants: observe plus read on provisioning and write on account, settings, oauth2, license, provisioning, blocklist, template

levels.description: Operate, plus delete accounts, applications, gateways and templates, revoke tokens, flush accounts and cancel queued messages
levels.grants: every pair of the mcp-manage table
read on account, mailbox, message, outbox, template

levels.description: Read, organize, draft and send. No delete tool
levels.grants: read plus write on message and send on submit
every pair of the mcp table

mcp.accessLevelRecord: A minted MCP token always carries permissions.grants listing the exact (action, group) pairs of the approved levels, never an absent record, so a consent given today does not grow to include a tool shipped later. No level mints tokens, reads a stored credential or an account's live OAuth2 access token, removes the license, exports a mailbox or subscribes to the change stream
mcp.toolSchemas: Narrower than the endpoints they wrap: operator-level fields are hidden, rendering options are pinned by the server, the settings tools leave out the privileged keys, and paged listings cap pageSize at 100. tools/list advertises only the tools the credential can call. A token bound to one account gets tools with no account argument - the binding is applied on dispatch - and loses every tool that takes none

resources.description: Each connected account the credential can see, readable as JSON

oauth.description: Dynamic client registration (RFC 7591) plus authorization code with mandatory PKCE. The consent page asks the admin for a level per section and issues an ordinary access token carrying the approved scopes and a grants record, revocable on the Access Tokens page

accountTypes.description: Reported only: Microsoft 365 shared mailbox borrowing another account's OAuth2 grant (oauth2.auth.delegatedAccount)
Reported only: SMTP-only account with no IMAP or OAuth2 configuration
Reported only: the account references an OAuth2 application that no longer exists
Reported only: delegated account whose parent account is missing or broken

accountStates.description: Not syncing: either no IMAP or OAuth2 configuration is set, or syncing was switched off, by the operator (imap.disabled) or automatically after repeated authentication failures (authFailureDisabledAt is set; re-authorizing or saving new IMAP settings resumes syncing)

errorCodes.description: Template, webhook route, OAuth2 app or gateway does not exist
The account has no SMTP or OAuth2 configuration to send with
The OAuth2 user is already bound to another account under the same OAuth2 application (re-registering an account ID is an update, not an error)
The IMAP server lacks an extension the request needs, such as a label filter on a non-Gmail server
POST /v1/tokens would create a token less restricted than the calling token
The account has not connected yet
The account's credentials are rejected; re-authorize
The mail server cannot be reached
Syncing is switched off for the account (state unset)
The account's IMAP connection is not up right now
A worker thread did not answer within EENGINE_TIMEOUT or the x-ee-timeout header

errorResponseNotes: Bodies are {statusCode, error, message} with error carrying the HTTP status phrase and message the explanation; code is present only for the codes above. A missing account is a plain 404 with no code, validation failures are 400 with a fields array, 401 responses carry no code, and 429 carries ttl (seconds until the window resets) plus a Retry-After header
